div.head: Ine 56
div.ab: C. Gif mon hwylcne ceap gebygeþ ⁊ he þonne onfinde him on hwylce unhælo binnon XXX nihta, þonne weorpe he ðone ceap to handa; oþþe swerige, þæt he him nan facen on nyste, þa he hine him sealde.
C. Gif mon hwelcne ceap gebygð ⁊ he ðonne onfinde him hwelc unhælo on binnan XXX nihta, þonne weorpe þone ceap to honda; oððe swerie, þæt he him nan facn on nyste, þa he hine him sealde.

Si aliquod uiuum captale persoluatur, et tunc inueniatur quelibet infirmitas in eo infra triginta noctes, reiciatur in manus to agenti; uel iuret, quod nullum facinus inesse sciebat, quando uendidit ei.
{C} Gif mon hwelcne ceap gebygð ⁊ he ðonne onfinde him hwelce unhælo on binnan XXX nihta, þonne weorpe þone ceap to honda; oððe swerie, þæt he him mnan facn on nyste, þa he hine him sealde.

If someone buys any property and within thirty days he finds some flaw in it, then he should return the property to the hands [of the seller]; or [the seller] must swear that he knew of no defect when he sold it to him.

If anyone buys any sort of beast, and then finds any manner of blemish in it within thirty days, he shall send it back to [its former] owner... or [the former owner] shall swear that he knew of no blemish in it when he sold it him.
If anyone buys any cattle and he then finds any unsoundness in it within 30 days, he is to hand it back to the seller, or [the latter] is to swear that he knew of no fraud when he sold it to him.

Wenn jemand irgend welches Vieh kauft und er dann binnen 30 Nächten irgend welchen Krankheitsfehler an demselben findet, liefere er das Vieh (dem [früheren] Eigenthümer) aus; oder [dieser] schwöre, dass er kein Fehl daran kannte, als er es ihm verkaufte.

If someone buys any livestock and he then finds any defect of disease in it within 30 nights, let him hand the livestock back (to the [former] owner); or let [the latter] swear that he knew of no fault in it when he sold it to him.
